scope: Read-only source review of the final metadata selection and data-preparation path. No geometric preparation, source CSV parsing by this reviewer, training, Slurm submission, or SSH was performed.

selection_evidence.CSV_handling_boundary: This reviewer checked file metadata and the frozen selection/CIF hashes; the 35 MB CSV was not parsed or rehashed here. Root separately reported a full selector/order and CIF verification.

source_call_review.direct_pure_inline_entrypoint: prepare_data.py:552 calls the hash-pinned inline.prepare_case(CIF path, block_adapter.TABLE) for each selected case; it does not invoke inline.prepare batch/output workflow.
source_call_review.module_binding: _load_adapters loads inline.prepare.py first under a private module name, then installs the pinned blockrunner prepare.py as sys.modules["prepare"], then removes/reloads score from BLOCK_ROOT. blockrunner score.py imports prepare, so score.audit is bound to that same pinned adapter.
source_call_review.source_pins: Current source pins cover the scaled32 helper, inline prepare.py, and blockrunner prepare.py/score.py before evaluation/row construction.
source_call_review.frozen_helper_contract: The actual frozen helper.prepare_row(case_id, selection_bytes, source_hashes, adapter, score) is used after per-case facts/plan generation. It verifies source plan/facts/text/CIF SHAs, plan/render equality, canonical normalization, exact second decode, CIF-vs-plan source geometry, source physical audit, plus/minus edit geometry and physical audits, and per-text K bounds.
source_call_review.packing_contract: The frozen helper.audit_packing runs over old48 plus all 224 new rows. Its pinned checks cover both directions, train variants 0/1 and heldout variant 0, all four arms, crystal-body K=2560 and packed MAXLEN=8192.

preparation_gates.streamed_case_progress: A per-attempt cases.jsonl is created before work; each case result is append-flushed immediately, and Slurm stdout progress is emitted every 10 cases and at 224.
preparation_gates.run100_runtime_pin: Before processing, the script requires run100 passed=100, all contracts passed, runtime_hashes_stable=true, and current plus saved source-snapshot hashes equal the run100 runtime_hash map. It repeats those checks after case processing/packing, requires current hashes and run100 summary SHA to remain unchanged, and returns failure before dataset commit on mismatch.
preparation_gates.split_specific_coverage: _coverage returns separate train, heldout, and all counts. Heldout unseen SG/Wyckoff coverage is computed against training-only SG/pair sets. The new CPU test covers these distinctions.
preparation_gates.commit_gate: The script writes data_001 only after exactly 224 results exist and all pass, aggregate packing passes, IDs/CIFs remain disjoint, and total split is exactly 272 records with train=256 and heldout=16. Records preserve the old48 JSONL byte prefix and publish via a temporary directory rename.
preparation_gates.no_overwrite: Existing data_001 or .data_001.tmp causes a refusal; failed/incomplete cases only produce a per-attempt failure summary and do not create data_001.

startup_failure_history.failure: Root-reported missing raw pilot import dependency before any selected-case processing.
startup_failure_history.scope_note: The failed attempt is historical evidence only; this review did not rerun it or inspect remote logs.

raw_cif_import_dependency_review.import_chain: Pinned inline.prepare.py imports cohort.py; cohort.py imports pilot.py; pilot.py imports benchmark.py and naturecry_codec.py. naturecry_codec.py imports wyckoff_baseline.py and test_program.py, which are already covered by the existing CNL runtime source map.
raw_cif_import_dependency_review.before_after_gate: prepare_stage hashes all three pinned files before loading/execution and again after per-case preparation; any missing file, mismatch, or change sets a failure before data_001 commit.
raw_cif_import_dependency_review.requests_import_note: pilot.py imports requests at module import time although its network chat functions are not invoked by inline.prepare_case. requests is not a member of the exact-version runtime policy. The actual Burgundy environment was not probed under this read-only/no-SSH review; package presence remains a runtime prerequisite.

runtime_environment_policy_review.evidence_boundary: Baseline versions were read from frozen data_pilot_001/manifest.json. Burgundy versions and successful CPU-test status were reported by root/owner; no remote session or environment was run by this reviewer.

nonblocking_notes: prepare_stage checks selection.sha256 against the current selection.json and records that digest in every output source pin; the expected 82707935…af25988 digest is not hard-coded as a constant in prepare_data.py. The current selection and all 224 frozen CIF inputs were independently checked here, select_stage refuses to replace an existing prepare_001, and the final audit should retain the verified selection SHA.
Runtime-source pins now include the three raw-CIF import files. A module-level requests import remains a compute-environment prerequisite but no network function is called by this preparation path.
